title: SMOK Nord 50W Replacement Pod
description:
Description
Specifications
Note: Sold individually. Please adjust the quantity to the desired number prior to ordering.
SMOK Nord 50W Replacement Pods come in the different types. The LP2 Pod is compatible with the SMOK LP2 Replacement Coil and has an e-liquid capacity of 4ml. The Nord Pod is compatible with the Nord series coil and has an e-liquid capacity of 4.5ml.
Accessory Quick Links:
SMOK LP2 Replacement Coils
SMOK Nord Replacement Coils
Side Fill System – Rubber Stoppered
Press-Fit Connection
Patented COP technology
Duck-billed Mouthpiece Design
Magnetic Pod Connection
